name: Phase T2: KG Agent Usability & Navigation Harness for Deucalion

criteria.description: scripts/kg_eval/engine.py builds an in-memory graph from case + preproc_out data and executes Cypher MATCH queries deterministically with syntax error feedback.
scripts/kg_eval/run_t2.py runs multi-turn agent loop with cypher() tool, logging queries, hops, syntax validity, and final answers.
scripts/kg_eval/score_t2.py scores runs across the 5 usability dimensions (query strategy, schema validity, error recovery, grounding discipline, knowing when to stop).
examples/deucalion/kg-eval-t2-pilot.sbatch passes bash -n and conforms to Deucalion staged launch rules.
